details.description: API keys and secrets are hardcoded in source (PAYMENT_TOKEN, MAIL_SERVER_KEY, INTERNAL_AUTH).
details.fix_explanation: Move secrets to environment variables and fail fast if not configured.

details.description: MD5 used for auth token generation which is cryptographically weak.
details.fix_explanation: Use SHA-256 for hashing sensitive tokens.

details.description: SQL query built with string formatting allowing injection via `uid`.
details.fix_explanation: Use parameterized queries and validate inputs.
details.secure_code_snippet: c.execute("SELECT id,name,balance FROM profiles WHERE id = ?", (uid,))

details.description: Unvalidated `notify_url` used in POST request to external URL.
details.fix_explanation: Require HTTPS and validate URL format; use timeouts and error handling.
details.secure_code_snippet:
if not url.startswith("https://"):
        raise ValueError("invalid notify_url")

details.description: update_records opens an arbitrary path from request without validation.
details.fix_explanation: Restrict to a configured safe directory and validate path normalization.

details.description: export_data uses shell=True with unvalidated filename leading to command injection.
details.fix_explanation: Avoid shell=True and pass argument list; validate filename.

details.description: app.run is invoked with debug=True which may leak sensitive info.
details.fix_explanation: Disable debug mode; use environment controlled settings.
